name: Paseo

runner.notes: Install desktop app or `npm i -g @getpaseo/cli` and start the local daemon, authenticate at least one guest coding CLI outside Paseo, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as the project (or create a worktree-isolated workspace from it), run prompt.md via `paseo run` / desktop / web, then harness-verify on the task worktree. Record Paseo version (e.g. 0.3.1), guest provider, isolation mode (worktree vs plain dir), and interventions. Headless CLI/daemon is preferred for automated smokes.

inclusion: Direct Class A self-hosted multi-agent ADE: open-source daemon plus desktop/web/mobile/CLI clients that run native guest coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Pi, and many more) with optional git worktrees, review/PR shipping, schedules, and remote access.
runtime_model_notes: Official: uses each provider's native harness as a subprocess; does not modify or wrap agent loop; BYO credentials.
pricing_model: Free and open source (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Bring-your-own guest agent subscriptions/keys. Optional hosted E2E relay and Paseo Hub features; re-check hub pricing if scoring hub-only flows.
public_stack_signals: Official site: orchestrate coding agents from desk and phone; self-hosted, multi-provider, open source.
Monorepo getpaseo/paseo; package.json license AGPL-3.0-or-later; npm CLI @getpaseo/cli; daemon on port 6767 by default.
Native CLIs for many agents (site agents page: 39 / +ACP custom); FAQ: subprocess launch, no token extraction.
Git worktree workspaces under ~/.paseo/worktrees with paseo.json setup/teardown/scripts/services.
Clients: desktop, web (app.paseo.sh), iOS/Android, CLI; optional E2E encrypted relay or direct/Tailscale connect.
capabilities_to_probe: parallel agents via CLI and UI (`paseo run`, attach, send)
optional git worktree isolation and workspace archive
inline diff review, commit, PR, merge flow
in-app browser preview of worktree services
mobile/web remote control over relay or direct daemon
moat_hypotheses: true multi-surface control (desktop/web/mobile/CLI) on a self-hosted daemon
broadest advertised native guest-CLI catalog plus ACP custom providers
worktree + service proxy workflow for parallel ship loops
AGPL open source with no forced login/telemetry (product claim)
setup_notes: Desktop: download from paseo.sh/download or GitHub releases (v0.3.1 multi-OS packages).
Headless: npm install -g @getpaseo/cli && paseo (starts local daemon).
Docker image ghcr.io/getpaseo/paseo:latest published; extend with guest CLIs.
Guest CLIs must already be installed and authenticated; Paseo does not replace them.
For Class A parity prefer local daemon + worktree isolation; record relay/hub separately if used.

research.positioning: A self-hosted, open-source control plane for running many native coding-agent CLIs in parallel—from desktop, web, mobile, or CLI—with optional git worktree isolation, review/PR shipping, and remote access without replacing provider harnesses or subscriptions.

backend: optional end-to-end encrypted relay for remote pairing
optional Paseo Hub for team triggers and multi-daemon coordination
worktree reverse proxy for per-workspace services
data: no product telemetry/forced login per README claim
unknowns: Exact desktop UI framework beyond monorepo packages not required for classification.
Hosted relay/Hub operational limits and any paid tiers should be re-checked before commercial claims.
Per-provider hook depth for the full 39-agent list needs install-time verification.

infrastructure: Default path is a local daemon on the operator machine; agents run with the full local dev environment.
Clients (desktop, web, mobile, CLI) connect to the daemon directly, over VPN/Tailscale, or via optional E2E encrypted relay.
Optional worktree isolation creates separate directories/branches under ~/.paseo/worktrees with setup/teardown hooks.
Model/API traffic is handled by each guest CLI under the user's existing credentials; Paseo claims it does not proxy inference.
Docker and remote hosts (e.g. VPS) are supported for headless daemons.

agent_support: many additional native CLIs plus ACP-compatible custom providers
orchestration: parallel multi-agent sessions from UI and CLI
paseo run / ls / attach / send scripting
optional Hub workflows and chat triggers
workspace_isolation: optional git worktree isolation (branch-off, checkout-branch, checkout-pr)
per-worktree setup/teardown and supervised services with reverse proxy
review_shipping: open PR and merge flows (product claim)
remote_mobile: iOS and Android apps with feature parity claim
E2E encrypted relay or direct/VPN connection
context_memory: workspace/session history in the daemon UI

install_surface: at least one authenticated guest coding CLI
parity_risks: Guest agent/model dominates single-task correctness (runtime_model guest-cli).
Worktree-backed runs write under ~/.paseo/worktrees by default—point harness verify at the actual agent cwd.
Relay/Hub and multi-host fleets are not parity-equivalent to local-only daemon runs.
Very broad provider list: detection quality varies; record exact guest runtime.
AGPL licensing may constrain proprietary embedding; fine for personal/bench use.

hypotheses: Mobile/desktop/CLI parity on a self-hosted daemon is a stronger remote story than desktop-only cockpits.
Native multi-harness catalog without reselling tokens matches power-user multi-CLI workflows.
Worktree + service proxy packaging reduces glue scripts for parallel features.
evidence: Official site and README document self-hosted daemon, multi-client surfaces, and native provider subprocesses.
Worktrees docs specify layout, isolation modes, and paseo.json automation.
package.json declares AGPL-3.0-or-later and multi-package monorepo including server/desktop/cli/mobile surfaces.
unknowns: Head-to-head orchestration quality vs Emdash/AgentsRoom/Orca is unscored.
Long-term maintenance and Hub commercial boundary not fully mapped in this pass.
